This synthetic stress fixture checks ordinary reading, not rich-content compatibility. A note can grow without becoming a chapter in a prescribed sequence.

## Reading across languages

Ideas need room to breathe. A long title should wrap rather than push navigation off the screen. **Emphasis remains legible**, and [a link to the notebook](/field-notes/) stays recognizable in prose.

Mixed-language typography sample: 笔记通过标签与链接组织知识，不是按章节排列的文档树。

> A notebook is a place for evolving ideas. The date and the classification provide context; neither is a mandatory reading order.
